benchmark_metadata.title: ChronoGrid Historical evaluation: Frozen Out-of-Sample Uncertainty Evaluation & Benchmark

evaluation_partition.auction_gate_closure: 12:00 Europe/Berlin (10:00 UTC CEST) on Day D-1

synthetic_regime_dropout_10days.description: Simulated 10-day numerical weather telemetry outage (Days 11-20); DDIR routes to Fallback and recovers

synthetic_regime_physical_outlier_5days.description: Simulated extreme temperature outlier (+85 C) triggering physical range validation failure and fallback demotion

objective_1_point_forecast_baseline_pari.statement: Weather-enabled research primary model achieves lower MAE and RMSE than load-only fallback on held-out data with zero leakage.
objective_1_point_forecast_baseline_pari.rationale: Primary model achieves 1,068.72 MW MAE vs 1,095.07 MW for Fallback (+26.35 MW advantage, 2.41% error reduction). Verified zero leakage across all 35 origins.

objective_2_marginal_conformal_coverage.statement: Non-adaptive split conformal calibration guarantees empirical marginal coverage >= 1 - alpha for nominal 90% and 95% on held-out evaluation.
objective_2_marginal_conformal_coverage.rationale: Both Primary (96.90% at 90%, 98.57% at 95%) and Fallback (95.71% at 90%, 98.45% at 95%) strictly exceed nominal targets. Intervals are conservative due to spring-to-summer residual distribution shift.

objective_3_simultaneous_daily_vector_co.statement: Vector-valued Sup-Norm Conformal achieves empirical coverage >= 90% across the 35 complete 24-hour daily delivery vectors.
objective_3_simultaneous_daily_vector_co.rationale: 100.0% of daily delivery vectors (35 out of 35 days) were completely contained within the 90% Sup-Norm band for both heads. MPIW expands to 11,755.4 MW (1.82x marginal).

objective_4_simultaneous_daily_vector_co.statement: Assess viability of 95% simultaneous daily vector envelope under small calibration sample size (N=75 origins).
objective_4_simultaneous_daily_vector_co.rationale: While empirical coverage is 100.0%, the interval width expands to 16,431.1 MW (~30% of total grid load). With N=75, k=73 leaves only 2 degrees of freedom in the upper tail. Viable only for exploratory research; requires N >= 150 daily origins for commercial deployment.

objective_5_delayed_feedback_aci_stabili.statement: Adaptive Conformal Inference with physical 48-hour grid settlement delay (tau=2 days, gamma=0.01) tracks miscoverage without numerical divergence or phase flapping.
objective_5_delayed_feedback_aci_stabili.rationale: Under 48h settlement feedback lag, alpha adjusts stably between 0.046 and 0.113 for Primary (mean 0.076) and 0.036 to 0.102 for Fallback (mean 0.068), achieving 97.14% and 97.26% coverage without oscillations.

objective_6_independent_fallback_calibra.statement: Standalone Fallback calibration pool operates without heuristic multiplier scaling (+25% / +50%) and maintains nominal coverage.
objective_6_independent_fallback_calibra.rationale: Fallback head achieves 95.71% coverage and 6,379.6 MW MPIW using purely its own calibration pool (q_0.90 = 5.552). Eliminating heuristic multipliers is mathematically sound and empirically validated.

objective_7_block_bootstrap_uncertainty_.statement: Daily-Origin Block Bootstrap (B=10,000) across block lengths b in {1, 2, 3, 5} days demonstrates robust confidence intervals despite serial autocorrelation.
objective_7_block_bootstrap_uncertainty_.rationale: Bootstrap SE is stable across block lengths (~1.26% to 1.30%). The 95% CI for b=2 is [94.17%, 99.05%]. Nominal 90% is strictly below the lower CI bound, verifying valid coverage under temporal dependence.

objective_8_synthetic_degradation_fault_.statement: DDIR state machine preserves prediction interval integrity during synthetic telemetry outages and recovers via hysteresis.
objective_8_synthetic_degradation_fault_.rationale: During simulated 10-day weather outage, coverage was maintained at 93.33% during the fault and 96.79% overall. Transitions were smooth with zero downtime.
